role: The entity renders that are not living models, from a recorded frame's "ents" (EntityRenderProbe): arrows, fireballs, RenderSnowball's sprites (snowballs, eggs, pearls, eyes of ender, splash potions, experience bottles), primed TNT with its flash, falling blocks, lightning bolts and Render.renderEntityOnFire; and ItemRenderer.renderItem for held stacks (the extruded sprite, the block model, the glint) and RenderBlocks.renderBlockAsItem, shared with the mob equipment.

structs.name: thing_item
structs.java: an ItemStack as ItemRenderer.renderItem and RenderBiped read it (EntityRenderProbe.stack)

gpu: file scope: static texture caches (tex_cache, blocks) filled from disk by scene path
raster_things_scene: reads and parses the frame row from disk per frame
notes: lane/entrender. Recorded scenes only; the live client does not call it. lane/covframes: block_atlas applies the animation again on every cached use, so the fire overlay (thing_fire) draws the frame's fire sprites, not the ones of the first frame that loaded the atlas (idx-burn-s1 31 1,175 to 18 px).
